subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class backup exclude policy now, and if so should `.backupignore` be auto-loaded by default or require explicit opt-in?
rationale: The branch adds user-visible backup policy, manifest/JSON behavior, protected-path semantics, and security-sensitive defaults; code review can identify blockers, but maintainers need to choose the permanent UX and compatibility contract before this surface lands.

options.title: Require explicit exclude input
options.body: Land backup excludes only behind explicit CLI/config inputs and do not auto-load `.backupignore` until maintainers approve that policy source.

options.title: Approve automatic `.backupignore`
options.body: Accept state-dir `.backupignore` as part of the backup policy contract, then require docs, upgrade notes, and tests for the implicit behavior.

options.title: Defer feature
options.body: Pause or close this branch and keep the linked backup exclude feature request as the canonical product discussion until the contract is re-scoped.

recommendation.title: Require explicit exclude input
recommendation.body: Land backup excludes only behind explicit CLI/config inputs and do not auto-load `.backupignore` until maintainers approve that policy source.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the backup CLI surface and is the strongest history signal for the user-facing backup command contract being extended.
